title: search_snippets contract is undocumented: notFound semantics
description: The search_snippets trait method says 'Return search snippets for the given Email ids' but does not state what to do with IDs that do not exist in the account. handle_search_snippet_get treats any ID not present in the backend response as notFound. If a backend implementor omits snippets for emails that don't match the filter (rather than returning a SearchSnippet with null fields), those emails are incorrectly placed in notFound. The fix is to add a doc comment specifying: 'For every ID in email_ids that exists in the account, return a SearchSnippet (subject and preview may be null if the email does not match the filter). Omit only IDs that do not exist in the account.'
